de: Der Enfield Town Market findet donnerstags bis samstags statt; er besteht seit 1303.
Nutzen Sie die London Overground ab der Station Enfield Town für eine direkte Verbindung in die Londoner Innenstadt.
Der Eintritt in das Gelände und das Herrenhaus des Forty Hall Estate ist völlig kostenlos.
Trent Park bietet riesige Waldgebiete an der Endstation der Piccadilly Line (Cockfosters).
hu: Látogass el az Enfield Town Marketre, ami csütörtöktől szombatig tart, és 1303 óta üzemel.
A londoni Overground vonattal az Enfield Town állomásról könnyedén eljuthatsz London központjába.
A gyönyörű Forty Hall Estate kastélyába és parkjába a belépés teljesen ingyenes.
A Trent Park hatalmas erdős területeket kínál rögtön a Piccadilly metróvonal végállomásánál (Cockfosters).
ro: Piața din Enfield Town este deschisă de joi până sâmbătă; tradiția ei datează din anul 1303.
Folosiți London Overground de la stația Enfield Town pentru un traseu direct spre centrul Londrei.
Intrarea pe domeniul și în conacul istoric Forty Hall Estate este complet gratuită.
Trent Park oferă o zonă naturală uriașă, accesibilă imediat de la capătul liniei de metrou Piccadilly.
en: Visit the Enfield Town Market, running Thursday to Saturday; it has been operating since 1303.
The London Overground from Enfield Town station is the easiest way to commute directly into central London.
Entry to the house and sprawling grounds of the Forty Hall Estate is completely free.
Trent Park offers a massive expanse of countryside right at the end of the Piccadilly Line (Cockfosters station).

de.name: Street Food auf dem Markt
de.tip: Probieren Sie an den Markttagen in Enfield Town frische internationale Imbisse von lokalen Händlern.

de.name: Sunday Roast
de.tip: Besuchen Sie die traditionellen Pubs am Rande des Trent Park für einen klassischen englischen Sonntagsbraten.

de.name: Britisches Café-Frühstück
de.tip: Suchen Sie ein traditionelles Café rund um die Church Street für ein klassisches 'Full English Breakfast'.

hu.name: Piaci street food
hu.tip: Piaci napokon kóstold meg a helyi árusok friss, nemzetközi ételeit Enfield központjában.

hu.name: Sunday Roast
hu.tip: Ülj be egy hagyományos pubba a Trent Park szélén egy klasszikus vasárnapi sülthöz.

hu.name: Klasszikus angol reggeli
hu.tip: Keress egy hagyományos kávézót a Church Street környékén egy bőséges 'Full English'-re.

ro.name: Street Food la piață
ro.tip: În zilele de piață, încercați mâncărurile proaspete internaționale preparate de comercianții locali.

ro.name: Sunday Roast
ro.tip: Rezervați o masă la pub-urile din jurul parcului Trent pentru o friptură tradițională de duminică.

ro.name: Mic dejun englezesc
ro.tip: Căutați o cafenea tradițională pe Church Street pentru un 'Full English Breakfast' autentic.

en.name: Market Street Food
en.tip: On market days, grab freshly cooked international food from the independent stalls in the town centre.

en.name: Sunday Roast
en.tip: Head to one of the traditional country-style pubs on the edge of Trent Park for a classic Sunday lunch.

en.name: Cafe Breakfast
en.tip: Find a traditional 'caff' around Church Street for a hearty, authentic Full English Breakfast.

de.name: Enfield Town Market
de.tip: Historischer Marktbereich, perfekt für frische Produkte und handwerkliche Lebensmittel.

de.name: Palace Gardens Shopping Centre

hu.name: Enfield Town Market
hu.tip: Történelmi piac, ahol friss zöldséget, gyümölcsöt és kézműves pékárut vehetsz.

hu.name: Palace Gardens bevásárlóközpont
hu.tip: Itt mindent megtalálsz, amire szükséged lehet a legismertebb márkáktól.

ro.name: Piața din Enfield Town

ro.name: Palace Gardens Shopping Centre
ro.tip: Principalul centru comercial acoperit din Enfield pentru magazine renumite.

en.name: Enfield Town Market

en.name: Palace Gardens Shopping Centre

de.name: Trent Park

de.name: Forty Hall Estate

hu.name: Trent Park

hu.name: Forty Hall Estate

hu.name: Myddelton House Gardens

ro.name: Trent Park

ro.name: Forty Hall Estate

ro.name: Grădinile Myddelton House

en.name: Trent Park
en.tip: A vast country park featuring ancient woodland, meadows, and lakes.

en.name: Forty Hall Estate

en.name: Myddelton House Gardens
